mcp.on.title: Switch on the MCP server?
mcp.on.message: An AI assistant that you start on this computer can then connect to Textida through the program {program}. It sees only the tabs you share with it (Tools, Share This Tab with MCP). It can read them, also text that is not saved, search in them and propose changes. It never writes: every proposal is shown to you as a change preview and you decide. Values in .env files stay hidden unless you allow them for a tab. You can withdraw a tab or switch the server off at any time. The tools it gets:

ide.on.title: Open the /ide bridge?
ide.on.message: Claude Code that you start in a terminal on this computer can then connect to Textida with the /ide command. Textida listens on this computer only (127.0.0.1, one port) and writes a lock file with a token into {folder}; only a program that can read that file can connect. The agent hears about the selection and the path of a tab only when you share the tab (Tools, Share This Tab with MCP). It never writes: every proposal is shown to you as a change preview and you decide. Diagnostics are empty for now.
